Includes a separate browser and an optional permission-gated Mac bridge for screenshots and installed apps. This is a release candidate, not a hosted shared bot. The product tour uses labelled sample data and scripted provider/account transports; remaining real-account/device checks are documented. Development and this owner-authorized submission were AI-assisted. Model/API/hosting costs can apply; Telegram traffic passes through Telegram.
